pyramiding_rule: No pyramiding into micro-pullbacks; add only on confirmed structural breakouts with volume expansion and an established trailing profit cushion.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Mandatory ATR-based volatility buffer: Initial Stop-Loss must be placed at least 1.5x the 14-period ATR away from entry price to prevent structural noise termination.
profit_harvest_threshold: Scale out 50% of position at +$10, trail remaining 50% with a dynamic parabolic SAR to capture asymmetric runs up to +$30.
